title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager  - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)**

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Manufacturing Engineering (Vehicle Assembly) is responsible for driving line balancing, process optimization, layout designing, and facility commissioning across vehicle assembly operations. Sitting at the intersection of process engineering and Industry 4.0, this role leads the procurement and integration of tooling, jigs, fixtures, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) testing facilities, and Low-Cost Automation (LCA) solutions. The incumbent executes line trials, implements ergonomic improvements (REBA/RULA), drives PFMEA and quality non-conformance root cause analysis, and embeds MES/IIoT traceability (Vehicle Genealogy) to ensure high-efficiency, safe, and cost-effective assembly operations up to final handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Line Balancing & Process Optimization:**
  Conduct time studies and workflow analyses to eliminate Non-Value-Added (NVA) activities, balancing assembly lines to boost efficiency and operational productivity.
* **Facility & Tooling Development:**
  Design plant layouts for expansions and handle end-to-end procurement (RFQ to DAP trials, site installation, and commissioning) for tools, jigs, fixtures, Poka-Yokes, and ABS testing facilities.
* **Industry 4.0 & Digital Manufacturing:**
  Integrate Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), IIoT networks, and Vehicle Genealogy tracking while executing Low-Cost Automation (LCA) and ergonomic upgrades (REBA/RULA).
* **Quality Governance & PFMEA:**
  Collaborate with Quality to resolve process non-conformances using 8D/A3 tools, update PFMEAs and Control Plans, and create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Cross-Functional & Packaging Support:**
  Provide daily shop-floor engineering support, resolve line bottlenecks, drive VAVE/cost-reduction projects, and oversee CKD packaging standards and material handling systems.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Mechatronics Engineering
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering / process engineering within automotive vehicle assembly environments (OEMs or major Tier-1 system integrators)
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end RFQ-to-commissioning execution, MES/IIoT integration, ABS facility testing, line balancing, and ergonomic workstation design

description:

**Who We Are**
Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
  
  
**Role Summary & Purpose**
Championing product integrity and consumer trust, you will architect and deploy the site Quality Master Plan and Quality Manual across Colgate-Palmolive’s high-speed Sri City manufacturing plant. You will drive a rigorous 'Right First Time' operational culture by auditing manufacturing systems, resolving Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) through CAPA, and leading technical bundle validations. Partnering directly with shop-floor operations and global audit teams, you eliminate process variation and customer complaints. Based on-site in Sri City, you ensure every toothbrush manufactured meets world-class quality and safety standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, document, and maintain the site Quality Master Plan, Quality Manual, and Global Quality standards compliance.
* Conduct internal audit programs and participate in Divisional and Corporate Quality Audits to evaluate site quality effectiveness.
* Lead root cause analysis and CAPA closures for all Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) in coordination with plant leadership.
* Manage the online Customer Response System (CRS), analyzing consumer complaints to drive continuous improvement.
* Monitor shop-floor quality KPIs and process capability to ensure all finished products fulfill KRSs (Key Release Specification) prior to market release.
* Deliver structured technical training and coaching to Quality Technicians, Operators, and plant line teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science or Technical stream (B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Tech) from a recognized university.
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of core experience in the FMCG industry with Quality & Production management responsibility.
* Quality Methodologies: Proven expertise in developing Quality Manuals, executing CAPA, NCR resolution, and process capability monitoring.
* Systems: Working knowledge of SAP (QM module), online CRS complaint management, and quality audit frameworks.

**Preferred Qualification & Experience**

* Industry: Experience in high-volume consumer goods (CPG/FMCG), oral care, or precision plastics manufacturing.
* Audit Expertise: Familiarity with international subsidiary benchmarking, cGMP, and EOHS site standards.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional training, coaching, and people facilitation capabilities with a strong decision-making mindset.
* Commercial Mindset: Understanding of plant financials, product commercialization bundles, and target cost delivery.

title: Overhead Equipment Manager
description:
**Company Description**
ML Enterprises LLP is a growing organization focused on delivering reliable, high-quality solutions across its operational and engineering activities. The company values safety, efficiency, and adherence to industry standards, especially in the management and maintenance of critical infrastructure and equipment. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their responsibilities while collaborating with colleagues to improve processes and outcomes. ML Enterprises LLP offers opportunities for professional development, stable employment, and the chance to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on day-to-day operations. The work environment emphasizes integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Role Description**
The Overhead Equipment Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Sullurpeta, responsible for overseeing the installation, operation, maintenance, and inspection of overhead equipment and related systems. The role includes planning and scheduling maintenance activities, coordinating with technicians and contractors, and ensuring all work follows safety regulations and technical standards. The manager will monitor equipment performance, troubleshoot issues, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports on asset condition, maintenance history, and required upgrades. Day-to-day tasks also involve managing inventory of spare parts, optimizing equipment uptime, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support project timelines and operational reliability. This role requires hands-on oversight in the field, regular site visits, and proactive risk identification to prevent equipment failures.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of overhead equipment systems, mechanical components, and basic electrical principles.
* Experience in maintenance planning, asset management, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in safety practices, risk assessment, and compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications for installation and maintenance activities.
* Effective organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple tasks and maintenance schedules.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Competence in using maintenance software or spreadsheets for record-keeping, reporting, and tracking assets.
* Previous experience in industrial, utilities, rail, or infrastructure environments is highly beneficial.
* Relevant technical diploma or degree in mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering (or equivalent experience).
* Ability to work on-site in Sullurpeta and perform regular field inspections and equipment checks.
